usage.outputShape: POST returns body.id (job id), body.status ("queued"), body.poll_url. Poll GET (paid) eventually returns the completed video URL in the body on first completed poll.
quirks: ASYNC: POST returns 202 with status:queued and a poll_url (relative path under blockrun.ai). Job is NOT done at POST time.

To poll, send GET to https://blockrun.ai + body.poll_url with an x-payment header signed by the SAME wallet that submitted the POST. The poll endpoint returns its own 402 challenge if unsigned, so x402 clients re-sign automatically.

EACH POLL COSTS MONEY (~$0.15/poll per registry async hint). Polling is NOT free. Expect status queued/in_progress then completed; video URL returned on first completed poll. Typical generation 60-180s.
PRICE MISMATCH: registry surface says $0.150 but actual x402 quote and charge was $0.420001 USDC (accepts.amount=420001). Duration defaults to 4 seconds.
Required body field is 'prompt' (text-to-video); 'model' must be 'azure/sora-2'.
payment_status:verified in the POST response body confirms the x402 payment was accepted server-side.
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/videos/generations with JSON {"model":"azure/sora-2","prompt":"<your prompt>"} and an x402 payment (~$0.42 USDC on Base, not the $0.15 listed). You get back a 202 with a job: body.id, body.status="queued", and body.poll_url. To get the finished video, GET https://blockrun.ai + body.poll_url with a fresh x-payment header signed by the SAME wallet — each poll is a paid x402 call (~$0.15). Repeat until body.status="completed" (typically 60-180s), at which point the response contains the video URL. Budget for the POST plus several paid polls.
